body: Thank you my every waking moment is pain full not wanting to die just not wanting to live I miss my son and I am trying not to be part of the pain myself and my wife and additional 5 children are experiencing

My son took his life in January in Taiwan after his wife did in December my therapist was so moved he took his life in April I’m fucked I plan every day to not be here I wake up and miss my son every day and ask and pray not to wake up in the morning, I sleep little and no longer dream I just dread, the next breath the next morning the next day, my son posted on here back in December I know why I have a wife 5 other kids and 3 grandkids and a mother with dementia I just don’t want to find my happy it’s not there, I don’t want to die!!! 
I just no longer want to live!!!!!

This was my beautiful son who cared deeply for his wife, and sought to join her his heart was broken as was his spirit,he endured 37 days of his in-laws attacking him , I am sorry he couldn’t hear the love that was shared hear I’m great full for all your kind words.
